name: Targeted Performance Fix
description: Make a measured, targeted performance improvement — profile to find the real bottleneck, optimize it, then prove the speedup with before/after numbers while keeping behavior correct. Profiles FIRST and locks a measurable target, because optimizing without measuring is guessing, then applies the focused change, then a reviewer confirms the improvement is real, behavior is unchanged, and the code is not needlessly obfuscated. Covers profiling/benchmarking, hotspot identification, algorithmic vs micro optimization, before/after measurement, and correctness-preserving speedups.
